note: Intra-process visibility of a blocking assignment: the second statement reads what the first just wrote. Every other clocked process in the corpus is non-blocking - pipeline3 deliberately reads previous values, multi_reg writes independent registers - so nothing here stated what `=` makes visible within one edge. Behavioral because swapping either statement to `<=` leaves a process with the same two statements writing the same two registers, one cycle apart; the stimulus steps d unevenly so a lagging b cannot coincide with a correct one.
